summaryZh: Su 研究团队关注年轻癌症幸存者的生殖健康，包括卵巢功能和生殖照护。团队开展观察性和干预性研究。

evidence.quote: Dr. H. Irene Su H. Irene Su, M.D. M.S.C.E. is Professor of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences, in the Division of Reproductive Endocrinology & Infertility. She is Program Director for the Reproductive Endocrinology & Infertility Fellowship, and Director of the Oncofertility Program at UC San Diego. UCSD Profile Improving the reproductive health of young people with cancer ​Our Research Nearly 60,000 girls, adolescents and young adult women are diagnosed with cancer each year. More than ever, young people will survive cancer and can look forward to the future. Cancer treatment can affect future fertility, pregnancy and the menopause. Currently, there is limited information to help young survivors, their families and their healthcare providers navigate these complex issues. Our research group conducts observational and interventional studies to help young cancer survivors improve their reproductive health. Read more about our research ​About the Research Team Our group conducts innovative patient oriented research studies to help young cancer survivors improve their reproductive health throughout the cancer continuum. Meet Our Team Lab Location Our research group is located on the 3 rd floor of the Moores UC San Diego Cancer Center Contact Us Recent Publications Desai M., Zhou B., Nalawade V., Murphy JD, Veeravalli N, Henk H, Gyamfi-Bannerman C, Whitcomb B, Su HI. Maternal Comorbidity and Adverse Perinatal Outcomes in Adolescent and Young Adult Cancer Survivors: a Cohort Study. British Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology, in press Publications

Su Lab – Dr. Irene Su's lab conducts innovative patient-oriented research studies on ovarian function, reproductive health, and reproductive care delivery, focused on adolescents and your adults with cancer.
